newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portucel says working near full capacity.
newsitem.headline: Portucel says working near full capacity.

text.p: Paper company Portucel Industral-Empresa Produtora de Celulose said on Wednesday it operated at 94 percent of capacity over the first six months of the year.
Variable costs per tonne fell eight percent over the period, it added in a statement.
The company made a consolidated net profit of 752 million escudos ($4.2 million) in the period, compared with a 2.9 billion escudo loss in the same period last year.
It said the 15 percent growth in sales reflected an increase in volume as the average price of pulp over the period was lower than at the start of 1996.
The company said that it had maintained its position as Europe's leading supplier of bleached eucalyptus kraft pulp , boosting sales of this product 14 percent year-on-year.
